nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Wildlife habitat preservation|Habitat monitoring programs_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the range of home range estimates for male individuals?
nodes.answer: Home range estimates for males range from 7.6 to 269.0 hectares.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Wildlife habitat preservation|Habitat monitoring programs_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What distinguishes the various techniques for analyzing acoustic data?
nodes.answer: The techniques are primarily distinguished by whether the analysis aims to identify species present or summarize the area's acoustic environment (soundscape).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Wildlife habitat preservation|Habitat monitoring programs_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What time period were the bird surveys conducted for the CBMS monitoring program in 2023?
nodes.answer: The bird surveys were conducted annually between March and June, specifically from March 1st to May 26th, 2023.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Wildlife habitat preservation|Habitat monitoring programs_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the purpose of the Dormouse Monitoring System (DoMoS)?
nodes.answer: The purpose of the Dormouse Monitoring System (DoMoS) is to know the site of occurrence of a species and record it together with habitat data.
